notes:
- New effect — Ducker: a drawable sidechain-pump built for EXCESS. Sketch the volume shape with movable start/middle/end points, shift-click the graph to add more, and bend any segment Ableton-style. Runs tempo-synced (quarter-note pump out of the box) or one-shot from an external sidechain input — feed it a kick and the pattern fires on every hit.
- Tremolo: square and saw shapes no longer click or pop — the gain edges are micro-smoothed so it stays choppy without the ticking.
- Trance Gate: per-step pitch with a label under each step (double-click to type a semitone, or scroll / shift-drag to nudge). The pitch engine was reworked so shifted steps are instant and click-free instead of audibly "scratching" up/down. Bigger grab zones for the level/length handles, and an option for more steps.
- Distortion: "Match Loudness" now ships OFF by default, so presets no longer come in hotter than expected.
- EQ / filters: live spectrum behind the curve, and Alt/Option-click a band to bypass it.
- Delay: the trailing repeat visualizer now lights each tap in time with host playback.
- Automation & MIDI: cleaner, host-friendly parameter names across DAWs, more macro lanes, and in-dial MIDI Learn / Unlearn.
- Third-party plug-ins in EXCESS: hardened keyboard passthrough so Spacebar (and Return) reach the DAW transport even while you're clicking inside a hosted plug-in's pop-up window.
- Stability: fixed a crash when dragging an EXCESS instance to another track, plus the ongoing safety net that scrubs non-finite samples and hard-limits runaway levels on every built-in effect.
